material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis indianapolis colts running back jonathan taylor said he 39 s ready for the nfl 39 s trade deadline to pass so he has a 34 verdict 34 on his future with or perhaps without the franchise that drafted him in 2020 34 the past couple weeks it 39 s kind of been the same thing 34 taylor said thursday of the rampant trade speculation about him 34 but it won 39 t be tuesday at that time because then you 39 ll know exactly what 39 s going on you 39 ll know exactly what the verdict is so you just have to continue to go to work you gotta go out here and try to win this game 34 the nfl 39 s trade deadline is tuesday at 4 p m et which could make sunday 39 s home game against the dallas cowboys nbsp the last time taylor suits up for the colts the three time pro bowler said he plans on treating it like a normal game 34 you try not to think about that because you don 39 t want external factors creeping in and trying to alter your play 34 he said 34 you want to go out there and have the same routine each and every single week because it 39 s worked so far throughout my career 34 the colts are 2 6 and have lost four straight games last week 39 s 42 7 road loss against the jacksonville jaguars was the franchise 39 s most lopsided defeat since 2017 taylor was limited to just eight carries his fewest since 2023 for 23 yards in the colts 39 ninth straight road loss what 39 s more indianapolis has lost 13 of its past 15 games and taylor has been held below 100 rushing yards in all 15 it 39 s the longest drought of his career the colts are likely headed toward their sixth straight season without a playoff berth and they 39 ve recently made a slew of major organizational changes that would suggest they 39 re rebuilding as a result trade rumors about taylor have only intensified the first domino to fall was when colts owner carlie irsay gordon fired general manager chris ballard on oct 19 less than 24 hours after the colts were booed off the field following a home loss to the previously winless tennessee titans eight days later the colts traded all pro left guard quenton nelson to the seattle seahawks for a 2027 third round pick and a 2028 fifth rounder and all pro defensive tackle deforest buckner to the san francisco 49ers for a 2027 fourth rounder unlike buckner and nelson who are on expiring contracts taylor signed a two year 44 million extension in august that puts him under contract through the 2028 season because taylor is more than a half year rental he 39 s viewed as the colts 39 hottest trade commodity and has plenty of suitors in recent weeks taylor repeatedly stated he hadn 39 t requested a trade however when asked thursday if that remains the case he didn 39 t give a clear answer 34 at this point the hay is in the barn now 34 taylor said 34 we 39 re preparing for the dallas cowboys 133 after last week nothing else matters we just gotta get these fans a win we gotta put out a great premium product it can 39 t be what we put out last week 34 taylor added he never considered sitting out sunday presumably to avoid a potential injury before the trade deadline nor did the colts coach shane steichen said taylor will have his usual workload against the cowboys the 27 year old has 148 carries for 610 yards and eight touchdowns through eight games this year as taylor prepares for his 93rd regular season game with the colts he conceded that it 39 s impossible to avoid all of the trade chatter particularly online and via social media his wife ayanna has even chimed in by releasing a series of tiktok videos about trade rumors involving her husband although jonathan taylor said her thoughts are not a direct reflection of his 34 this waiting game is driving me crazy 34 ayanna taylor said via tiktok 34 i feel like a prized calf waiting for the slaughter it 39 s gonna happen today tomorrow is it never gonna happen and i genuinely cannot decide what 39 s worse being blindsided and sent away or being the last one standing and knowing what may be coming 34 taylor set the colts 39 single game rushing record 253 yards as a rookie in 2020 he won the league rushing title 1 811 yards en route to a first team all pro nod in 2021 and last year he became the colts 39 all time leader in rushing touchdowns now at 77 surpassing hall of famer edgerrin james obviously with a resume like that taylor will always be revered in indianapolis but the next few days will determine whether he 39 ll continue to call it home 34 everybody wants clarity 34 taylor said 34 no one wants uncertainty 34 material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

material_news_signals.description: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: sometimes nfl teams do make the obvious moves the baltimore ravens are finalizing a trade for arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday the deal is expected to be completed over the weekend terms of the swap were not reported and cardinals head coach mike lafleur declined to go into details or confirm the deal out of respect for the process i ll let the process play out with that said lafleur via the cardinals website s darren urban before adding he expected it all to play out in the next few days brissett was benched during sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and demoted to third string on monday the benching coupled with the ravens glaring need at quarterback after losing lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury this week made a swap all too obvious not only was the need clear but brissett will reunite with ravens qb coach israel woolfolk with whom he worked last season in arizona and in cleveland in 2022 that familiarity will help the veteran qb to jump right into the fray it made sense for arizona to move on from brissett after naming gardner minshew the starter and carson beck the backup eventually beck should get some starting reps by trading brissett the cards also shed salary after reworking the qb s deal this offseason the ravens won t acquire brissett before thursday s game against jacksonville but he s expected to start when baltimore faces the los angeles chargers in week 10 on monday night football undrafted rookie joe fagnano will start on thursday night football versus the jags the ravens will be brissett s seventh franchise and mark his seventh different team in seven years the journeyman knows how to pick up an offense and can run the operation in arizona some off target throws began to hurt the offense and he didn t seem the best fit in mike lafleur s scheme but he s a professional who can at least give the ravens an operational distributor losers of three straight heading into thursday night the ravens hope brissett s arrival can help keep them afloat in a tough playoff race baltimore currently sits last in the division at 4 4 and 10th in the afc

material_news_signals.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
material_news_signals.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against material_news_signals.headline: Kyle Shanahan admits 49ers explored Jauan Jennings trade, but WR 'pretty happy' in Minnesota
material_news_signals.description: San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan on Wednesday discussed his team's pursuit of a deal for veteran receiver Jauan Jennings.
material_news_signals.body_text: the san francisco 49ers find themselves in another division title race and in need of some help at receiver naturally the 49ers turned toward a familiar face former niner and current vikings receiver jauan jennings when contemplating potential acquisitions ahead of tuesday s trade deadline as things moved closer toward possibly becoming a reality head coach kyle shanahan was permitted to talk with his former receiver about a potential deal and learned jennings was not interested in a reunion we love jauan we have such a good relationship with jauan and know him really well and we didn t want to do it without talking to him first shanahan explained wednesday when asked about an earlier report on their interest in jennings so we had to agree on some things to at least make it close enough to be able to talk to him then when we got on a facetime with j j it went well it was awesome we talked about a lot of stuff and he ended up saying that he was happy with where he was it wasn t just like a definite no first but he was like man kyle i m pretty happy here and liking stuff and when i heard the way he talked and where we re at i agreed with him so it was a good conversation and something that was possible but that s why it didn t go down a trusted secondary option during his five years spent in san francisco jennings embraced his next professional opportunity with a vikings team that welcomed him in as the third option behind justin jefferson and jordan addison in 2026 on paper the fit made sense jennings reliable production would pair nicely with jefferson addison and an offense that was expected to be propelled by quarterback kyler murray the results haven t matched the expectation minnesota is 6 1 but has earned those victories on the back of its elite defense while the offense has lagged significantly behind unsurprisingly jennings has proven to be irrelevant in the low ceiling offense catching six passes for 54 yards in six games one might believe that would lead jennings to want out but as shanahan discovered jennings seems to be enjoying the vikings success despite his lack of involvement with that door closed the 49ers will have to look elsewhere for help in a position group that already lost ricky pearsall to a season ending knee injury and is still hoping mike evans can return before long from a week 7 achilles injury they look every week to see who you can add week in and week out shanahan said of san francisco s pursuit of an addition at receiver it gets bigger as the trade deadline comes but j j was someone we knew so someone we wanted to talk to if we went through with that and they were willing to do it at the time we wanted to have a conversation with him knowing the guy receivers is something we still are looking into and so is every other position jennings meanwhile will hope minnesota s 31st ranked passing attack can find a rhythm before december

material_news_signals.headline: Texans' Will Anderson: Justin Herbert 'playing out of his mind' for winless Chargers
material_news_signals.description: Houston's Will Anderson Jr. will face Justin Herbert and the Chargers in Week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent -- even if it's, well, a bit inaccurate.
material_news_signals.body_text: we re learning a lesson about how tone can change depending on timing take texans edge rusher will anderson he is part of a houston team that will face justin herbert and the chargers in week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent even if it s well a bit inaccurate he s still a really great quarterback in this league anderson said of herbert on wednesday you talk about a big guy that has a big arm that can run around that can throw the ball deep makes a lot of plays with his legs he s still a very respectable player in this league and we have a ton of respect for them pretty standard fare so far but anderson didn t stop there and that s when things exited reality and ventured elsewhere we know what to expect a little bit but herbert he s playing out of his mind he continued they have a really great solid offensive line as well and some really good running backs that can get downhill that can hit the perimeter it s going to be a good challenge for us anderson could have stopped at we have a ton of respect for them but continued into a fictional realm as a means of avoiding providing bulletin board material those who have watched herbert and the chargers the nfl s only winless team know the quarterback hasn t played well and neither have his teammates one might wonder whether out of his mind meant herbert was playing without the full scope of his faculties his touchdown to interception ratio 5 10 would match such a description perhaps we should just let last week s opponent the los angeles rams quentin lake summarize what has actually occurred he was throwing deli meat out there lake said during an appearance on the st brown podcast he s seeing ghosts i don t know what s going on but we knew we were going to get a couple of interceptions at least one the rams ended up snagging two with lake grabbing the first midway through the first quarter by sliding underneath herbert s intended target for one of the easier takeaways he ll log in his professional career fellow rams defensive back trent mcduffie hauled in the other in a 24 9 win over the chargers look herbert is deeply mired in the roughest stretch of his pro career while playing in an offense that clearly doesn t fit the chargers strengths offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel remains employed in los angeles but for how long remains to be seen if coach jim harbaugh is looking for a fall guy amid this disastrous season mcdaniel makes for an easy mark that s what makes anderson s comments baffling los angeles owns the nfl s 28th ranked offense in yards per game 26th in passing yards per game and 31st in interception rate the operation is a mess and herbert can t stop making things worse at least anderson achieved one goal he didn t give the chargers additional motivational material judging by what s happened up to this point in the season though it s unlikely he ll match the edge rusher s description sunday it might just be part of anderson s grand plan to soften up his next target

and benching tanner mckee for sunday s game versus the new york giants nfl network s mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported the eagles signed milton off the dallas cowboys practice squad on oct 16 after starter jalen hurts went on injured reserve due to blood clots a 2024 sixth round pick by the new england patriots milton has appeared in five games in his career all as a reserve while he wasn t the official starter in week 18 of his rookie campaign with the patriots he played the bulk of the tilt completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and ran for another score last year in dallas he subbed in four tilts completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with a td and two ints and rushing for 50 yards on five carries an enticing athlete milton brings a completely different style from mckee milton s ability to use his legs should help an offense that has struggled to block and suffered far too many stalled drives the strong armed 26 year old can hunt big plays which also can get him into trouble he ll get a shot to prove he can evolve with more seasoning in philly the eagles bench mckee after three starts all losses he completed 72 of 114 passes for 638 yards and two tds with two ints in sunday s loss to washington the eagles couldn t find consistent offense under mckee after the first quarter and a 10 0 lead turned into a 27 10 loss mckee lost the preseason backup battle to andy dalton and entered the season as qb3 however after dalton s one wayward interception against the bears in week 3 while hurts was getting checked for a concussion philly moved on from dalton who eventually signed in atlanta now the eagles are on to qb4 with sixth straight losses philly s season feels all but over for nick sirianni s club it doesn t hurt to see what an athlete like milton could provide things can t get much worse and milton at least provides the upside to make the offense exciting once in a while

material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another material_news_signals.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week
